ground_truth_root_cause: NTP clock synchronization failure on frontend-node-01 and frontend-node-02 caused both nodes to run +47 seconds ahead of actual time. When these nodes handle payment requests, the payment-service JWT validator compares the token exp claim against the node local clock. With the clock skewed +47 seconds forward, all JWTs including freshly issued ones with 5-minute lifetimes appear expired, causing 100% of requests routed through these two frontend nodes to receive HTTP 401. The ntpd logs at 14:20:02 UTC explicitly record clock offset +47.312s detected on both nodes and report that automatic slewing was disabled, meaning the skew was not self-correcting. The payment-service logs consistently show delta=+47s on every failed JWT validation.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately force ntpd step correction on both frontend nodes: sudo systemctl stop ntpd and sudo ntpdate -b ntp1.internal and sudo systemctl start ntpd. 2. Verify clock sync via chronyc tracking or ntpq -p on both nodes and confirm offset falls below 1 second. 3. Confirm payment-service recovers automatically once clocks are corrected with no restart required. 4. If ntpd is misconfigured check /etc/ntp.conf for correct stratum-2 peers and ensure firewall allows UDP 123 to NTP servers. 5. Post-incident: add a monitoring alert for NTP offset greater than 5 seconds on all frontend nodes to catch clock drift before it impacts JWT validation.
red_herring: The email-service deploy (SHA e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4, authored by lisa.tran at 13:10 UTC) appears suspicious because: (a) it was deployed exactly 35 minutes before the incident began at 14:23 UTC and touches SMTP relay configuration, a change to external service credentials that could plausibly affect downstream payment flows if payment confirmations or fraud-check callbacks depend on email delivery state; (b) however the logs exonerate this deploy entirely: at 14:18:04 UTC the email-service logs confirm Test email dispatched successfully via Postmark, at 14:23:15 UTC Postmark relay is logged as healthy with 3 transactional emails delivered, and at 14:23:22 UTC the payment-service itself logs that email-service SMTP migration completed at 14:18 UTC and email subsystem is healthy and unrelated to current auth failures. The true cause is unambiguously visible in the logs: ntpd errors at 14:20:02-03 UTC show both frontend nodes at +47s clock offset with automatic correction suspended, and every single JWT failure log entry shows delta=+47s, with payment-service itself warning at 14:23:13 that all failing JWT errors show consistent server_time delta of approximately +47 seconds above token exp.
